0x000A0C.en: 「With what I've got now...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x000A7D.en: 「Gah!@　So this is where it ends...!!」

0x000B05.en: 「Dammit!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x000C2E.en: 「Is this as far as I go...!?」

0x000C66.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, geez!」

0x000D2F.en: 「Ngh! So this is where it ends...!」

0x000D6A.en: 「Blowing it in a place like this...!@　Not funny...」

0x000DBE.en: 「I blew it...!@　Nothing to do but pull out...」

0x000F0F.en: 「This is as far as I go... the rest is up to you.」

0x000FBB.en: 「No good, I've taken too much... I'm pulling back!」

0x001008.en: 「Well, this is a fix. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x001046.en: 「Kyaa! The rest is up to you!」

0x001138.en: 「Ngh... So I'm the one who becomes a shooting star... Ejecting!」

0x0011EF.en: 「Ow ow ow... You got me. A miscalculation.」

0x001230.en: 「Oh brother, they went and got me!」

0x001274.en: 「Ngh...! So this is where it ends...!」

0x0012E1.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x001328.en: 「I'm sorry. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x00135D.en: 「Damn it! Is this the limit of my power...!」

0x0013A1.en: 「I can't fight any longer! I'm retreating!」

0x00141A.en: 「Ngh... You're as good as they say.」

0x001449.en: 「To be beaten in a place like this...@ I've still got a long way to go...!」

0x001497.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! I'm retreating!」

0x001552.en: 「Sorry, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x0015BF.en: 「Well, well. So this is where it ends.」

0x0015EE.en: 「I can't go on any further. Do forgive me for taking my leave.」

0x001641.en: 「A bitter loss... I'll withdraw for now.」

0x001679.en: 「Was I careless...@ I'll pull back here...!」

0x0017DF.en: 「Ejecting now...@ Ngh...! Not a very graceful exit...」

0x00189D.en: 「Guhh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x001A0C.en: 「So I still have much to learn...!」

0x001AAF.en: 「No good, they got me for real.」

0x001AE1.en: 「Guess I've got no choice but to fall back...!」

0x001B8E.en: 「Gentlemen... as you know, the Hagane of the Steel Dragon Squadron@ is bound for this Grand Christmas.」

0x001C0E.en: 「Distinguished veterans of the last war, yet they joined anti-Federation forces, rebelled against us, and killed the President.」

0x001D00.en: 「By agreement with the Earth Federation Army,@ the Hagane should be headed here to surrender@ its personnel into our custody, but...」

0x001D9C.en: 「Behind them are those who believe the false footage@ Shu Shirakawa spread and now doubt us...」

0x001E22.en: 「and the scheming of Marshal Gaspard Gillan,@ who resents the Gaia Sabers, lurking just out of sight.」

0x001E93.en: 「In all likelihood, the Hagane will feign compliance@ with our summons, draw as close as they can,@ and try to probe our intentions.」

0x001F41.en: 「But we cannot simply overlook them@ when they have mistaken who their true enemy is.」

0x001FA3.en: 「We will lure them here to Grand Christmas,@ seize their combat strength, and put it to good use@ in our war against the outside threat.」

0x002033.en: 「Furthermore, should they refuse our orders,@ attack is authorized. Some losses are unavoidable, but...」

0x0020B9.en: 「Capture the Re-Tech and Melior Esse units@ as intact as possible. That is all.」

0x00211B.en: (...Whether or not they submit to seizure,@ I'll kill Ing and Sanger and the rest with my own hands.)

0x002196.en: (Even if they meekly hand over their heads, there's no thrill in the cut.)

0x0021EC.en: (There are ways to seize the Steel Dragon Squadron's strength@ without a direct clash... surer ways, at that...)

0x00226C.en: (It was the same back then...@ Commander Alteur cornered them, then@ practically let them slip away...)

0x0022F9.en: (Even after, he fed in his forces piecemeal,@ never trying to land a decisive blow...)

0x00235B.en: (Does the Commander have some other intent...?)

0x0023E9.en: 「But the MODEL-X is essential for the decisive battle@ with the Steel Dragon Squadron. And the one who can@ draw out its power best is my AI1.」

0x0024B0.en: 「Then what would you have us do?@ Duvan Org has run off, you know.」

0x002540.en: 「Someone more capable than my child?@ If we don't prove the MODEL-X's worth now,@ the Zentr Project will...」

0x0025F1.en: 「Let me be blunt, then.@ I have no intention of indulging your twisted love any further.」

0x00267B.en: 「The AI1 is dangerous.@ I'll say it as many times as I must -@ I will not have it installed in the MODEL-X.」

0x0026FC.en: 「My TE Absorber has no need@ for such a thing.」

0x0027DA.en: 「K-kill me here, and you won't get off easy either!」

0x002823.en: 「For the AI1's sake, I'll do anything.」

0x00285D.en: 「A-all right! I'll do as you say!@ So please, spare my life...!」

0x0028C2.en: 「...This is how I killed Albero, too.」

0x00293B.en: 「Heh... they came quietly enough, didn't they.」

0x00297C.en: 「Don't tell me those guys... mean to just surrender?」

0x0029C9.en: 「That'd be easier, and fine by me.」

0x0029EB.en: 「Don't be stupid. That way there's no glory to earn.」

0x002A2B.en: 「No need to worry.@ They've got a blade hidden in their bellies.」

0x002A78.en: 「Then I'm glad to hear it.@ I'll pay them back for last time right here.@ And cut ties with them while I'm at it.」

0x002B02.en: 「Hey, let's just start already.@ We're gonna end up killing each other anyway.」

0x002B67.en: 「Don't get ahead of yourself.@ If someone sinks the Hagane now, the glory@ all goes to whoever did it.」

0x002C13.en: 「Quiet, all of you. Wait. The more prey, the better.」

0x002C53.en: 「See, the captain says so.@ No jumping the gun, Chien.」

0x002D46.en: 「Attention, Steel Dragon Squadron.@ I am Colonel Carly Nauman,@ captain of the Gaia Sabers' flagship.」

0x002DD4.en: 「Your repeated acts of rebellion are unforgivable.@ Disarm at once and hand over every mobile weapon@ in your possession to us.」

0x002E6A.en: 「Be aware that this is by order of Special Deputy@ President Alteur Steinbeck.」

0x002ED5.en: 「Once you have disarmed, all personnel will be taken into custody.@ Should you refuse, we will commence a full assault.」

0x002F4C.en: 「...Lee... no, Colonel Carly.@ There's one thing I want to ask.」

0x002FA8.en: 「You have no right to ask questions. Obey the order.」

0x002FE8.en: 「What do the Gaia Sabers...@ what does Alteur Steinbeck...@ intend to do with us?」

0x003072.en: 「I have already stated it. Obey the order.」

0x0030A6.en: 「Regarding former President Grusman, suspicion has fallen on your side too - the Federal Assembly is questioning it as well...」

0x003157.en: 「You mean that leaked footage. There's no truth to it.@　Ask one more question and I'll take it as intent to@　rebel, and open fire.」

0x003211.en: 「As for the charges against us, I'll answer them in the proper place, once we've driven off the threat over Earth's sphere.」

0x0032DB.en: 「Colonel! Aren't Ruina and Baral the ones we@　should be fighting right now!?」

0x003346.en: 「Naive as ever, I see. There is no such grace period,@　no such choice. You will be dealt with, right here.」

0x0033D3.en: 「...And Alteur Steinbeck, the one who gave that@　order... do you really trust him...!?」

0x003466.en: 「I trust nothing. I believe he has some other aim,@　and that he's set us up.」

0x0034DA.en: 「We are the Gaia Sabers, formed to defend Earth's@　sphere. There is no room to doubt our leader,@　Commander Alteur.」

0x0035B6.en: 「...Baseless slander. We, the Gaia Sabers, are the@ force that guards Earth's sphere and saves@ its people.」

0x003640.en: 「It's the nature of that force I'm questioning.@　If you won't stand down, I'll press on ahead...@　and expose Alteur's scheme!」

0x0036EB.en: 「A martyr to your own error, then.@　All ships, commence attack!」

0x003775.en: 「All Tesla Drives to thrust, vector straight down!@　Upper starboard thrusters, full burn, four seconds!@　Rapid descent, dive!」

0x00382D.en: 「We managed to weather it, but more enemy missiles@　incoming fast! Trails sighted!」

0x003892.en: 「Down ten degrees! Hard to starboard, minimum radius!@　Port side, forward thrusters, burn four seconds!」

0x003909.en: 「Drop the Energy Field!@　Launch all units in sequence!」

0x0039BE.en: 「Bring us back! Energy Field, deploy!@　Report damage on the impacted sections!」

0x003A29.en: 「Tch, deflecting the hull like that while still@　launching your craft!」

0x003ABC.en: 「Fool! You think you can break through here!?」

0x003B08.en: 「Yeah, I'm a fool. I know exactly what shape Earth's@　sphere is in right now, and I'm still trading fire@　with you here...!」

0x003BEE.en: 「You lot, enough already!@　Us fighting here doesn't mean a thing!」

0x003C62.en: 「It means plenty to us.@　Beating you down and racking up the credit.」

0x003CCD.en: 「That's right. The <Boosted Children> brand is one@　only WE get to carry!」

0x003D6B.en: 「If you hate fighting that much, then be a good boy@　and lay your head down in front of me!@　I told you before, I'll vaporize you in a flash!」

0x003E19.en: 「...If I could, I'd rather not fight them.」

0x003E5F.en: 「They're a pain, and it's such a hassle.@　Couldn't you just do what Chienne says?」

0x003ED0.en: 「That'd be the easiest. Well? What do you say? Heheh.」

0x003F38.en: 「Then I'll send you all off to join Aurum 1.@　Make nice with him. Oh, and if Agila or Adler@　are there, give 'em this message for me...」

0x00400A.en: 「I've got grudges, sure, but by now...@　I'm even a little grateful!」

0x00406F.en: 「I'll live it up for your sakes too!@　Though I'll forget all about a pack of@　washouts soon enough!」

0x004105.en: 「Say what you want, we're moving forward!@　If you don't want to die, get out of the way!@　Fall back from here!」

0x004195.en: 「You think a line like that scares us,@　huh!?」

0x0041EB.en: 「...Barking louder than usual, aren't you, little puppies.」

0x004253.en: 「Well, yeah, that's true, but...@　they're not mammoths.」

0x0042A9.en: 「Rishu, Sanger...@　The hour of our final duel to the death.」

0x0042FC.en: 「No more words... We settle it here.」

0x004339.en: 「We shall shatter that wicked, heretic blade with@　our Colossus Blade!」

0x004385.en: 「Hmph, I'll slaughter your whole school!@　With the head house gone, I'll inherit the style!」

0x0043F6.en: 「All units, commence attack!@　Break the enemy line and open a path@　to the Grand Christmas!」

0x00446B.en: 「Ngh! That we should be pushed back like this...!」

0x00450E.en: 「D-damn it...! That we should be driven back like this!」

0x004557.en: 「...It's me. Air Christmas, fall back to the@　final defense line.」

0x0045DB.en: 「This is an order, Captain. That ship is one of my@　trump cards. I can't have it lost here. Withdraw@　at once.」

0x004693.en: 「Air Christmas is breaking away@　from the current combat zone!」

0x0046E3.en: 「The tide's turning our way!@　Destroy the remaining enemies in the zone!」

0x004739.en: 「It was a short acquaintance, Arado!@　This is where you and I part ways too!」

0x004795.en: 「Like hell it ends in a place like this!@　We've still got someone we have@　to fight!」

0x004810.en: 「This is the end, washout!@　Give me a good show! Scream nice and loud!」

0x004881.en: 「I'm proud of how much I can take!@　It'll take a lot more than this to make me cry out!」

0x0048FB.en: 「Then I'll just have to look forward to@　your dying scream instead!」

0x004954.en: 「Don't screw with me! I'm not fighting@　to entertain you!」

0x0049B9.en: 「...Seriously, just hurry up and die.@　I'm sick of your face, and I hate sweaty guys.」

0x004A2D.en: 「If it's such a bother, then quit fighting!」

0x004A73.en: 「Killing guys like you? I enjoy that.@　I just don't want it to take long, is all.@　Haha!」

0x004AFA.en: 「Come on, Seolla!@　Aurum 1 is waiting for you in the next world!」

0x004B4A.en: 「I never want to hear you talk about@　my sister Ouka ever again!」

0x004BA0.en: 「Then shall I shut your mouth for you!?@　Ha! You, who were pickled in Limako,@　shutting MY mouth!」

0x004C15.en: 「Look who's talking! We've come this far -@ you can't stop us now!」

0x004C83.en: 「We don't need any Boosted Children but us!@　Go rot right here!」

0x004D3A.en: 「Nobody's asking to be saved.@　From where we stand, you're the ones@　who look pathetic.」

0x004DBE.en: 「Like, you're all tied down by such worthless junk!」

0x004E01.en: 「I don't think it's worthless at all!」

0x004E3E.en: 「You actually think you can beat the Gaia Sabers.@　It's stupid, really.」

0x004EA6.en: 「Say that line after you've beaten me!」

0x004EE6.en: 「When you die, the Latooni type is finished!@　The only Boosted Children we need are us,@　the Argent!」

0x004F94.en: 「If there were other <School> survivors left,@　you'd do the same thing to those kids...!?」

0x005032.en: 「Then I'll end it here...!@　I'll stop you!」

0x005085.en: 「I'll give you credit for the guts to pick a fight@　with the Gaia Sabers head-on.」

0x0050ED.en: 「You're being used by Alteur...@　Your positions will reverse soon enough.」

0x005155.en: 「Fool!@　You'll die before that ever happens!@　As a loser!」

0x0051B2.en: 「Just give up already.@ Push on and you'll get the same result.」

0x005267.en: 「...True. But the path you take to get there differs.」

0x0052B4.en: 「Hahaha! Albero couldn't even live by his own@　teaching! Dead, it doesn't mean a thing!」

0x005385.en: 「Can you survive here!@　Up against us!」

0x0053D2.en: 「The Cry Wolves are down to just you now!@　Let me hear it, the howl of a beaten wolf!」

0x005440.en: 「Oh, I'll howl all right...@　after I've torn your throat out!」

0x00549C.en: 「Where is Erde Mitte!?@　What is she doing right now!?」

0x0054EF.en: 「No reason to tell you, no reason for you to know!@　You're all dying here anyway!」

0x005569.en: 「Get out of the way! I have no business with you!」

0x0055AF.en: 「Word is Erde chewed you out and you went@　yipping and whimpering.@　Let me hear it too!」

0x005636.en: 「You said it now...!@　Open the way, or you're the one who'll@　end up whimpering!」

0x0056AB.en: 「Here, lament the fate that turns you to rust upon my@　blade!」

0x0056F8.en: 「My sword-spirit will never be cut by the likes@　of you! Your heresy ends here!」

0x005760.en: 「Rishu!@　I'll inherit your Colossus Blade as well!」

0x0057B0.en: 「Murata, you'll gain neither the Colossus Blade@　nor the enlightenment of the Asura...」

0x00581B.en: 「I sever this path of evil, here and now!」

0x005849.en: 「I-it's only just beginning for me!@　I'll beat them and make my name...!!」

0x0058B4.en: 「Like hell I'll die, like hell!@　That's right, being tough as nails is another@　selling point of the Boosted Children!」

0x00593E.en: 「I'll get away, I'll get clean away...!」

0x0059BC.en: 「Y-you bastards! How dare you, how dare you!!」

0x005A3C.en: 「I-I don't want to be a loser!!@　I'm gonna be a winner, a winner!!」

0x005A9E.en: 「That's right, if I get through here,@　I'm definitely a winner...!!」

0x005B13.en: 「Y-you people! How dare you do this!!」

0x005B87.en: 「T-this, nobody told me about this!@　No way, no way!!」

0x005BE0.en: 「I-I'll kill you! You too!@　All of you, I'll kill you all!!」

0x005C86.en: 「Damn it! You bastards! I'll kill you all!!」

0x005CCF.en: 「T-this, nobody told me about this!@　No way, no way!!」

0x005D3B.en: 「That's why I told you... to fall back from here...」

0x005D7E.en: 「Nnh! Guh! Well done!@　But my blade still...!!」

0x005DF9.en: 「Give it up, Murata.@　Far from mastering the way of the Asura,@　you've gained no enlightenment of the sword.」

0x005E8A.en: 「Bound by worldly desire, fallen to evil, blind to@　truth. Just as your machine's name says...@　"Mumyo" - benighted.」

0x005F6C.en: 「...I told you.@　I am the blade that cuts down evil.」

0x005FBC.en: 「A heretic's sword can never cut me down.」

0x005FF0.en: 「So be it... My Colossus Blade shall guide you@　to the underworld.」

0x006033.en: 「D-damn you, Sanger!!@　Who's going to any underworld! The path I walk...!!」

0x0060A4.en: 「...I told you.@　There is nothing I cannot cut.」

0x0060F1.en: 「B-beyond that lies what I seek!@　The enlightenment of the Asura...!!」

0x006187.en: 「No response from enemy craft in the zone!@　Course is secured!」

0x0061D4.en: 「Good, we press straight on to the Grand Christmas!」
